question: Should the refreshed exact head be merged once the reported lint failure is confirmed as unrelated to this patch?
rationale: The implementation and real behavior proof are strong, but the protected `maintainer` label and unresolved exact-head gate require an explicit human merge decision.

options.title: Refresh and merge
options.body: Update against current main, rerun the required exact-head gates, and merge if the failure is absent or demonstrably baseline-only.

options.title: Pause for gate repair
options.body: Keep the PR open if the refreshed head shows a changed-surface lint or test failure attributable to this patch.

recommendation.title: Refresh and merge
recommendation.body: Update against current main, rerun the required exact-head gates, and merge if the failure is absent or demonstrably baseline-only.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release-snapshot history and the protected merge state make this the best available routing candidate for the final exact-head decision.
